g.text: Fixed 2025 AI exposure quintiles; annual survey-weighted employed-person stocks.
Attainment proxy retained from the corrected panel. These are all-age workers, not new graduates or graduate employment rates.
Small postgraduate cells and changing cohort composition should be considered when interpreting the trajectories.
